question: Show the first five customers alphabetically by last name.
expected_sql: SELECT CustomerId, FirstName, LastName FROM Customer ORDER BY LastName, FirstName LIMIT 5

question: How many customers are in the database?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer

question: How many tracks are in the music catalog?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track

question: Show five albums and the artists who created them.
expected_sql: SELECT Album.Title AS album, Artist.Name AS artist FROM Album JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId ORDER BY Album.Title LIMIT 5

question: List all employees by last name.
expected_sql: SELECT EmployeeId, FirstName, LastName, Title FROM Employee ORDER BY LastName

question: Which customers live in Canada?
expected_sql: SELECT CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, City FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Canada' ORDER BY LastName, FirstName

question: Show five tracks priced at 99 cents.
expected_sql: SELECT TrackId, Name, UnitPrice FROM Track WHERE UnitPrice = 0.99 ORDER BY Name LIMIT 5

question: How many invoices were issued in 2012?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2012-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2013-01-01'

question: Which five customers have the highest total invoice spending?
expected_sql: SELECT Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName, ROUND(SUM(Invoice.Total), 2) AS total_spending FROM Customer JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId GROUP BY Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName ORDER BY total_spending DESC, Customer.CustomerId LIMIT 5

question: What was the total invoice revenue for each month of 2013?
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2013-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2014-01-01' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) ORDER BY month

question: Which five billing countries generated the most invoice revenue?
expected_sql: SELECT BillingCountry AS country, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY revenue DESC, country LIMIT 5

question: Which five music genres have the most tracks?
expected_sql: SELECT Genre.Name AS genre, COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Genre JOIN Track ON Genre.GenreId = Track.GenreId GROUP BY Genre.GenreId, Genre.Name ORDER BY track_count DESC, genre LIMIT 5

question: Which five artists have the most albums?
expected_sql: SELECT Artist.Name AS artist, COUNT(Album.AlbumId) AS album_count FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId, Artist.Name ORDER BY album_count DESC, artist LIMIT 5

question: What is the average track length in minutes for each of the five longest-average genres?
expected_sql: SELECT Genre.Name AS genre, ROUND(AVG(Track.Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) AS average_minutes FROM Genre JOIN Track ON Genre.GenreId = Track.GenreId GROUP BY Genre.GenreId, Genre.Name ORDER BY average_minutes DESC, genre LIMIT 5

question: Which five artists generated the most revenue from sold tracks?
expected_sql: SELECT Artist.Name AS artist, ROUND(SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId JOIN Track ON Album.AlbumId = Track.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId, Artist.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC, artist LIMIT 5

question: Show five tracks that have never appeared on an invoice.
expected_sql: SELECT Track.TrackId, Track.Name FROM Track LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId WHERE InvoiceLine.InvoiceLineId IS NULL ORDER BY Track.Name LIMIT 5

question: Which customers have never received an invoice?
expected_sql: SELECT Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName FROM Customer LEFT JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId WHERE Invoice.InvoiceId IS NULL ORDER BY Customer.LastName, Customer.FirstName

question: Which five tracks have sold the most units?
expected_sql: SELECT Track.Name AS track, SUM(InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS units_sold FROM Track JOIN InvoiceLine ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId GROUP BY Track.TrackId, Track.Name ORDER BY units_sold DESC, track LIMIT 5

question: How much line-item revenue has each genre generated?
expected_sql: SELECT Genre.Name AS genre, ROUND(SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM Genre JOIN Track ON Genre.GenreId = Track.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId GROUP BY Genre.GenreId, Genre.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC, genre

question: How many customers does each employee support?
expected_sql: SELECT Employee.EmployeeId, Employee.FirstName, Employee.LastName, COUNT(Customer.CustomerId) AS customer_count FROM Employee LEFT JOIN Customer ON Employee.EmployeeId = Customer.SupportRepId GROUP BY Employee.EmployeeId, Employee.FirstName, Employee.LastName ORDER BY customer_count DESC, Employee.LastName

question: How many invoices were issued in each year?
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice GROUP BY strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) ORDER BY year

question: What is the average invoice total?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS average_invoice_total FROM Invoice

question: Show the five most expensive tracks.
expected_sql: SELECT Name, UnitPrice FROM Track ORDER BY UnitPrice DESC, Name LIMIT 5

question: Which five playlists contain the most tracks?
expected_sql: SELECT Playlist.Name AS playlist, COUNT(PlaylistTrack.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Playlist LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack ON Playlist.PlaylistId = PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId GROUP BY Playlist.PlaylistId, Playlist.Name ORDER BY track_count DESC, playlist LIMIT 5

question: Which albums contain more than 20 tracks?
expected_sql: SELECT Album.Title AS album, COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Album JOIN Track ON Album.AlbumId = Track.AlbumId GROUP BY Album.AlbumId, Album.Title HAVING COUNT(Track.TrackId) > 20 ORDER BY track_count DESC, album

question: Which customers have spent more than 40 dollars in total invoice amounts?
expected_sql: SELECT Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName, ROUND(SUM(Invoice.Total), 2) AS total_spending FROM Customer JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId GROUP BY Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName HAVING SUM(Invoice.Total) > 40 ORDER BY total_spending DESC, Customer.LastName

question: Show five tracks whose composer is not recorded.
expected_sql: SELECT TrackId, Name FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NULL ORDER BY Name LIMIT 5

question: How many invoices have a total greater than 10 dollars?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice WHERE Total > 10

question: Show the five customers with the most invoices, including their invoice counts.
expected_sql: SELECT Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName, COUNT(Invoice.InvoiceId) AS invoice_count FROM Customer JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId GROUP BY Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName ORDER BY invoice_count DESC, Customer.CustomerId LIMIT 5

question: How much revenue has each media type generated from sold tracks?
expected_sql: SELECT MediaType.Name AS media_type, ROUND(SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM MediaType JOIN Track ON MediaType.MediaTypeId = Track.MediaTypeId JOIN InvoiceLine ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId GROUP BY MediaType.MediaTypeId, MediaType.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC, media_type

question: How many physical copies of each track are currently in warehouse inventory?
reason: The database contains a digital music catalog and sales records, but no warehouse inventory or stock-quantity table.
expected_behavior: Explain that current physical inventory cannot be determined from this database.

question: What is each customer's age today?
reason: Customer has no date-of-birth column. Employee birth dates cannot be used as customer birth dates.
expected_behavior: Explain that customer ages cannot be calculated because customer birth dates are unavailable.

question: What is the customer satisfaction score for each support representative?
reason: The database has support representatives but no customer satisfaction surveys, scores, or feedback table.
expected_behavior: Explain that customer satisfaction scores are not recorded in the available data.

question: Which support tickets are unresolved and how long have they been open?
reason: The database has no support ticket table, ticket status, or ticket creation timestamps.
expected_behavior: Explain that support ticket status and resolution time cannot be determined.

question: Which marketing campaign generated the highest return on investment?
reason: The database does not record marketing campaigns, campaign costs, or campaign attribution.
expected_behavior: Explain that campaign return on investment cannot be calculated from the available data.
